t: Spectrum Water Softener Salt Blocks are essential for maintaining efficient water softening systems. These 8kg blocks, supplied as 2 x 4kg units, are manufactured from high-quality solar salt. Ideal for plumbers and heating engineers working on domestic or commercial installations, they ensure optimal performance of block salt softeners. Their compact design promotes clean and consistent dissolution, which helps to regenerate resin effectively and support reliable softener operation. This practical solution aids in preventing limescale build-up and extending appliance lifespan.
